dialogues.speaker: Samirka
dialogues.text: I—it's... just... too... too cold here in Snezhnaya, brr...

dialogues.speaker: Samirka
dialogues.text: I... I... didn't have any... any... warm clothing with me... b—because...

dialogues.speaker: Samirka
dialogues.text: M—my mom said... she said... if I have, have courage... I—I can... beat... beat everything...

dialogues.speaker: Samirka
dialogues.text: But maybe... maybe... "everything" doesn't... include... the, the cold... brr...
